meta.description: Daily curated Claude AI skills news for small and medium businesses

entries.title: r/claudeskills: Skill Function — Move Claude Skills to Cloud Endpoints for Secure, Multi-Model Routing
entries.summary: A developer proposes 'Skill Function' — skills that live as cloud endpoints instead of local files, each running in isolated contexts with its own dedicated model (7B for simple tasks, 70B for complex ones). SMB owners should watch this: it addresses the #1 concern with skills — security (42% of public skills have vulnerabilities) — while dramatically cutting costs by routing tasks to the right model size instead of burning flagship tokens on everything.

entries.title: r/claudeskills: Open-Source Skill to Search and Reply on X — Automate Your SMB's Social Engagement
entries.summary: A solo dev built an open-source Claude skill that searches X/Twitter by query and date, pulls post metrics (views, likes, comments), and lets you reply directly from the agent. SMBs can use this for social listening, competitor monitoring, and engagement automation — no LLM needed to run the skill itself. Works with Claude Code, Codex, and Claude Desktop.

entries.title: Claude Code's 'Extended Thinking' Output Is Encrypted — You Can't Audit Your Agent's Reasoning
entries.summary: Critical finding for SMBs using Claude Code: Anthropic encrypts the full reasoning process and only returns a summary. Local reasoning logs contain an encrypted signature, not actual thinking text. If your business needs audit trails, compliance documentation, or transparency around how your AI agent arrives at decisions, you cannot get the full reasoning without an enterprise agreement. Share this with anyone in your org who's using Claude Code for client-facing work.

entries.title: HN: Pulse — Local Dashboard for Claude Code Lets You Approve Tool Calls From Your Phone
entries.summary: Pulse is a zero-dependency local dashboard that reads Claude Code sessions from disk to show live token spend, recover lost sessions, and send phone push notifications with Allow/Deny buttons for tool call approvals. SMB owners using Claude Code remotely can approve critical actions from anywhere — even on cellular — with no Wi-Fi or open ports needed. Install with a single npx command.

entries.title: Anthropic Rolling Out Identity Verification on Claude — What It Means for SMB Accounts
entries.summary: Anthropic is rolling out government-ID verification via Persona for certain Claude capabilities. SMB owners using Claude for business should be prepared to verify accounts, and should note that failed verification will not allow simple account recreation — the system matches identities across accounts. If your team uses Claude professionally, ensure the account holder has a valid, unexpired government ID ready.

entries.title: Forbes: Claude For SMB's 10-City Road Trip + 15 Built-In Workflows You Can Use Today
entries.summary: Anthropic's Claude For Small Business is running a 10-city road trip (Dallas included on May 14) offering free half-day AI training to 100 small business leaders per city. The package embeds 15 workflow-based AI apps directly inside QuickBooks, PayPal, HubSpot, Canva, DocuSign, Google Workspace, and Microsoft 365 — no new software needed. SMB owners should ask their current tool vendors whether Claude workflows are enabled and start using them immediately.

entries.title: BBC: Claude Fable 5 Suspended Over Jailbreak Vulnerabilities — What SMBs Need to Know
entries.summary: The US government issued an export control directive suspending Claude Fable 5 and Mythos 5 due to jailbreak bypass capabilities. The UK AI Security Institute found the model could exploit defenses 73% of the time. SMBs using any Fable 5-based tools should pause deployments, audit for vulnerabilities, and wait for patched versions before trusting AI with sensitive business data.

entries.title: Awesome Claude Skills Catalog Hits 10,384 Skills — New Business & Productivity Domain
entries.summary: The open-source Awesome Claude Skills catalog has surpassed 10,000 skills, now organized into 13 domains including a dedicated Business & Productivity section. SMB owners can browse by domain to find ready-made skills for finance, marketing, ops, and HR — or contribute their own business workflows to help the community.

entries.title: Anthropic Ships Enterprise-Managed MCP Auth — SMBs Can Now Set Up Connectors Once for All Employees
entries.summary: Claude now supports centralized MCP connector authorization via Okta — admins provision connectors once and every team member gets zero-touch access on first login. For SMBs with a part-time tech person, this means setting up QuickBooks, HubSpot, or Google Workspace integration for the whole team in one go. Available today in beta on Team and Enterprise plans.

entries.title: CSO Online: Security Considerations for Adopting Claude Code and Cowork as an SMB — Your Action Plan
entries.summary: A security leader shares hard-won lessons from deploying Claude at an SMB: phased feature enablement, risk-ranking MCPs vs. direct integrations, managing shadow AI (half of employees use unsanctioned tools), and provisioning by need rather than blanket access. The article even suggests asking Claude to help you risk-rank your own setup. Essential reading before giving your team wide-open access.

entries.title: Blotato: Free Claude Skills Pack — 7 Skills to Go From Blank Page to Scheduled Social Post
entries.summary: A ready-to-use skill pack with 7 skills for small-business social media automation: content-coach (auto-runs the workflow), brand-brief, post-writer, post-grader, post-scheduler, repurpose, and viral-hooks. Works in Claude Code, Desktop, and Cowork. One-time install, use forever. SMB owners: pick up and down immediately for Instagram, LinkedIn, or X scheduling.

entries.title: Medium: 5 AI Business Ideas I Personally Built — One Is a Claude MCP Server That Writes Blog Posts From YouTube Videos
entries.summary: A practitioner shares five real businesses he's built with AI — the star is an MCP server that takes a YouTube link or keyword, generates blog posts with images and SEO, and publishes them live. He built it entirely with Claude Code via Claude Desktop. SMB owners can replicate this exact pattern for their own content marketing using free tools.

entries.title: Slite: Why Claude Code Needs a Company Brain — 18 Workflows That Replace Stacking MCPs
entries.summary: A deep-dive into why chaining MCPs for context retrieval burns through session limits and tokens fast. The solution: a dedicated 'company brain' (Slite Agent) that gives Claude Code instant access to your docs without flooding the context window. Setup takes ~10 minutes. SMB owners who've been tripping on rate limits with multiple MCP servers will find an immediate fix.

entries.title: StayHypd: Replace $6K/Month of Back-Office Work With Claude Max and 11 MCPs — 75+ Skills, Full Breakdown
entries.summary: A complete recipe for replacing eight back-office roles (accounting, HR, ops, marketing, sales, legal, admin, and analytics) with a single Claude Max subscription ($200/mo), 11 MCP servers, and 75+ skills. Includes the exact install order and working prompts for each function. SMB owners who currently pay $6K+/month for junior staff could potentially cut costs significantly.

entries.title: BuildFastWithAI: How to Create, Connect, Upload & Improve Claude Skills (2026 Guide)
entries.summary: A newly published guide walks SMB owners and freelancers through creating, uploading, and improving Claude skills step-by-step. If you have a repeatable business process (invoice processing, client onboarding, content repurposing), this tutorial shows you how to turn it into a reusable skill that runs automatically.

entries.title: Taskade: What Are Claude Skills? A 2026 Beginner Guide for Non-Technical Users
entries.summary: Taskade published a beginner-friendly explainer breaking down what Claude Skills are, how they differ from tools and MCP servers, and why they matter for SMBs. If you have not yet explored skills yet, this is the best starting point to understand the concept before diving into your first automation.

entries.title: MarkTechPost: Claude Code Guide 2026 — 25 Features SMBs Can Leverage for Automation
entries.summary: A comprehensive breakdown of 25 Claude Code features — from CLAUDE.md memory files to plugins, hooks, subagents, and MCP integrations. SMBs with even a part-time developer can use this as a playbook: pick the features matching your highest-friction workflows and start automating today.
